newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promet to raise stake in IPCO.
newsitem.headline: Promet to raise stake in IPCO.

text.p: Malaysia's Promet Bhd said on Monday it has received acceptance of 6.25 million shares or 15.77 percent of the paid-up capital of IPCO International Ltd shares at the close of its takeover offer last Friday.
This will raise Promet's stake in infrastructure concern IPCO to 74.98 percent, Promet said in a statement.
Promet made a mandatory general offer for the remaining 11.73 million IPCO shares it does not own at S$1.70 each on November 19, 1996.

The offer was made after acquiring, through its subsidiary Oradea Pte Ltd, a 29.6 percent in IPCO from Australian-based Leighton Holdings Ltd for $28.15 million. At that point, the purchase raised its combined interest in IPCO to 59.21 percent.
Promet has said that the acquisition of IPCO will enhance the company's position as a world leader in the infrastructure sector.

IPCO's current infrastructure business and operations cover Southeast Asia, Africa, Middle East and South America. Promet is engaged in infrastructure development covering mainly the Southeast Asian and Indian sub-continent markets.
